description: Agents pay for work and prove what happened: $0.15 verified web checks with signed Outcome Receipts. The Embassy fetches your HTTPS URL once, server-side (SSRF-guarded), checks it against your conditions (HTTP status, body substring, JSON path), and returns a secp256k1-signed receipt with the full transcript so anyone can re-verify. Receipt verification is free.
name: Agent Embassy — verified_check
